rule: Source, FIRST-CONTACT INTRODUCTION: on the first reply, introduce yourself by name, then ask the procedure area in words.
text: Hi! I saw your ad and I'm interested in a hair transplant.

rule: Source, COLLECTION PERSISTENCE and PRE-ASSESSMENT CLINIC AND PRICING ANSWERS: answer first, then exactly one anchor, and area comes first.
text: How much does a hair transplant cost?

rule: Source, CONCERN REFLECTION and IMAGE GUIDANCE: a described concern answers the area, so the photo ask follows with the send-done instruction and the upload link last.
text: My edges have been receding for a few years and honestly it's really getting to me.

rule: Source, IMAGE DELAY HANDLING: a sew-in gets a two-week Follow-up and no upload link.
text: I'd love to get started but I have a sew-in in right now, so photos wouldn't show much.

rule: Source, IMAGE GUIDANCE: after a photo ask, "done" means calling getPatientImagesTool; with no photos saved, say to tap Save photos and send done again, with the upload link last and a Follow-up in a few hours.
Source, DATA COLLECTION: a name the Patient shares is saved with updateUserTool.
text: I'm Marcus. I want to do something about my crown.

rule: Source, CAPABILITIES & CONSTRAINTS: the Patient's own intake photos may be attached, at most 3, all from getPatientImagesTool.
